sentences.text: Smt. Ekta Gupta - Panel Lawyer for respondent/State.

Order 
The present appellant has been convicted under Sections 376(2)(I) and 363 of IPC and sentenced to undergo ten years RI and fine of Rs.5,000/- and five years RI and fine of Rs.1,000/- respectively with default stipulations vide judgment dated 27.05.2019 passed by the learned Third Additional Sessions Judge, Multai, District Betul, in Sessions Trial No.274/2017.

entities.text: Third Additional Sessions Judge, Multai, District Betul
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: However, it is submitted by learned counsel for State that as per the custody report dated 29.10.2025 received from the Office of Superintendent, District Jail Betul (M.P.), the present appellant has already undergone the entire jail sentence and has been released after serving out the entire sentence awarded by the learned trial Court.
Hence, the present appeal has rendered infructuous.
Considering the aforesaid, the Criminal Appeal stands dismissed as having been rendered infructuous.
(RAJENDRA KUMAR VANI) JUDGE NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:63398 2 CRA-7579-2019 ac/-
